blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists may see mixed oil price movements next week, with gasoline set for another hike and diesel prices likely to fall. In an advisory, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said the prices of gasoline may inch up by P1.50 to P1.80 per liter. READ: Iran says received US response to its proposal to end war Diesel, on the other hand, may dip by 50 centavos to 80 centavos. Bellas’ estimates were based on the first four days of trading at the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS), and foreign exchange movements. MOPS is the basis for the pricing of refined […]...
